title: ToolListResult
description:
Result of the `tools/list` RPC.

# Examples

``` use zhive_proto::rpc::ToolListResult; let r = ToolListResult::new(vec![]); let v = serde_json::to_value(&r).unwrap(); assert_eq!(v["tools"], serde_json::json!([])); let back: ToolListResult = serde_json::from_value(v).unwrap(); assert!(back.tools.is_empty()); ```

tools.description: All engine-registered tools, sorted by name.

ToolSpec.description:
Metadata descriptor for one engine-registered tool.

Returned by the `tools/list` RPC to let clients discover which tools the connected engine instance exposes, their input schema, and a coarse classification for UI grouping.

# Examples

``` use zhive_proto::rpc::{ToolSpec, ToolSpecKind}; let spec = ToolSpec::new( "read_file".into(), Some("Read a file from the filesystem.".into()), ToolSpecKind::Read, serde_json::json!({ "type": "object", "properties": { "path": { "type": "string" } } }), ); let v = serde_json::to_value(&spec).unwrap(); assert_eq!(v["name"], "read_file"); assert_eq!(v["kind"], "read"); let back: ToolSpec = serde_json::from_value(v).unwrap(); assert_eq!(back, spec); ```

description.description: Human-readable description, if the tool provides one.

inputSchema.description:
JSON Schema (object) describing the tool's input arguments.

Intentionally kept as opaque `Value`: tool input schemas are tool-defined and not validated at the proto layer.

name.description: Stable tool name matching the engine's dispatch key.

ToolSpecKind.description:
Coarse classification of a discoverable tool.

Wire mirror of the engine's `domain::ToolKind`; defined as a separate type so that the discovery and display concerns can evolve independently. Zero-cost conversion from [`ToolKind`] is provided via [`From`].

# Examples

``` use zhive_proto::rpc::ToolSpecKind; let v = serde_json::to_value(ToolSpecKind::Read).unwrap(); assert_eq!(v, "read"); let back: ToolSpecKind = serde_json::from_value(v).unwrap(); assert_eq!(back, ToolSpecKind::Read); ```
